evals.prompt: Write a function in fp-go v2 that takes a list of User structs (each with Name string and Age int fields), filters to only users over 18, extracts their names, and joins them with a comma. Use Flow/Pipe and point-free style. Also generate a unit test.
evals.expected_output: A pure pipeline returned from a function (not a package-level var), e.g. func adultNames() func([]User) string built with F.Flow2(A.FilterMap(...), A.Intercalate(S.Monoid)(",")). No reader monad, because the computation needs no environment. The age check is point-free (F.Flow2(getAge, N.MoreThan(18)) as a P.Predicate[User]) and field access uses named accessors or lens getters, not inline lambdas. Includes a _test.go using assert.Equal. All imports from github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2 with the canonical aliases (F, A, O, N, P, S).

A function processOrder(orderID string) RIO.ReaderIOResult[Invoice] (RIO = github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2/context/readerioresult; no environment type parameter) or processOrder() RIO.Kleisli[string, Invoice]. The db calls are lifted with RIO.Eitherize1 instead of hand-written closures. Do-notation uses RIO.Do(Invoice{}), RIO.Bind with lens setters for the dependent db calls (F.Flow2(lens.Get, kleisli) to feed the previous field) and RIO.Let for the pure calculateTotal. No ctx parameter inside the pipeline. The test runs the pipeline with t.Context() and compares against R.Of(expected). All imports from github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2.

evals.prompt: I have a Config struct with Host string, Port int, and TLS bool fields. Write fp-go v2 lenses for each field, then write a function that reads the Config from the reader environment and returns a formatted connection string like 'https://host:port'. Use point-free style, no inline functions in the pipe. Generate a test.
evals.expected_output: Three lenses built with L.MakeLens (github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2/optics/lens) or generated via // fp-go:Lens. A function connectionString() RD.Reader[Config, string] (RD = github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2/reader) that uses RD.Asks or F.Pipe with RD.Ask[Config]() and RD.Map, referencing the lens getters by name (not inline); only the multi-field formatter leaf may be a lambda. A _test.go passes a concrete Config struct and checks the returned string. All imports from github.com/IBM/fp-go/v2 with canonical aliases.
